title: Fake Merc Character Study (part. 11): Blowhard Bloho
summary: Part 11 of NH's hostile character study of YouTuber Jason Blowho. NH claims to have obtained the man's private messages and accuses him of having no coaching clients, faking medical conditions (Meniere's, deafness, PTSD) for excuses and disability money, using fake plates and an over-high squat box, and constantly blaming others. These are NH's allegations; the few fitness takeaways concern box height, scarcity marketing and taking responsibility.
claims: NH says he personally doesn't care about strength; he trains for size
NH argues looks matter a lot for attractiveness, with personality helping on top
Scarcity marketing ('only two spots left') is a classic way to fake demand for coaching
NH alleges the YouTuber passes off strangers' Facebook lifting videos as his clients' and won't show proof of payment
NH alleges the YouTuber's 'box squat' box is 15-18 in rather than the claimed 12 in, which inflates his box squat compared with his free squat
Box squats let lifters without enough thoracic extension load heavy weights they couldn't take to depth
A real coach or veteran lifter should be able to tell good advice from bad; blaming a viewer for your own injury is avoiding responsibility
Nobody forces you to eat junk food; blaming a partner for your weight gain shows weakness
